name: Transmission
description: Transmission is designed for easy, powerful use. Transmission has the features you want from a BitTorrent client: encryption, a web interface, peer exchange, magnet links, DHT, µTP, UPnP and NAT-PMP port forwarding, webseed support, watch directories, tracker editing, global and per-torrent speed limits, and more.
short_desc: Transmission is designed for easy, powerful use
author: linuxserver.io

form_fields.label: TRANSMISSION_WEB_HOME
form_fields.hint: Specify the path to an alternative UI folder.

form_fields.label: USER
form_fields.hint: Specify an optional username for the interface

form_fields.label: PASS
form_fields.hint: Specify an optional password for the interface

form_fields.label: WHITELIST
form_fields.hint: Specify an optional list of comma separated ip whitelist. Fills rpc-whitelist setting.

form_fields.label: PEERPORT
form_fields.hint: Specify an optional port for torrent TCP/UDP connections. Fills peer-port setting.

form_fields.label: HOST_WHITELIST
form_fields.hint: Specify an optional list of comma separated dns name whitelist. Fills rpc-host-whitelist setting.
